title: Storage driver factory threads the elicited backend answer through as driver.backend
asA: operator eliciting the storage backend at apply time
iWant: the shipped storage driver factory to accept the elicited answer and report it as driver.backend
soThat: a downstream operations panel and a review probe can read the shipped-backend value from the driver instance and cross-check against the elicited answer

acceptanceCriteria.description: createInMemoryDoStorage({backend: "sql"}) returns a driver whose .backend property equals "sql"; createInMemoryDoStorage({backend: "kv"}) returns a driver whose .backend property equals "kv"; createInMemoryDoStorage({}) defaults to "sql" per ADR-3403 recommendedDefault. The driver.backend field is present on every returned driver.
acceptanceCriteria.given: three factory calls with backend="sql", backend="kv" and no backend arg
acceptanceCriteria.then: each driver.backend reports the elicited answer or the default "sql"
